_doc: Match rules and tuning. Distances in metres, times in seconds.

deathmatch._doc: Team Wipe is the default: last team standing earns one point, first to 10/20/30/50 wins. Players and field reset each round. Kill-score, timer and single-round elimination are also available. Malasugue Mall's field is disabled by default; enabled fields use the usual schedule and stop at half the initial radius.

map_limits._doc: Freight Delight: two teams only, up to 12 a side (12 by default when the map is picked).

deathmatch._zone_speed: r14: Deathmatch always runs its field at this speed (the lobby's Normal/Fast/Rapid is for Classic only): 250 s from the first circle to nothing.
deathmatch._day_offsets: r17: a round always starts at night (was 0/150/300/450 s into the cycle).

official._doc: Always-on official servers (src/match/official.gd, docs/HOSTING.md). The stats URL is the default when Settings > Online is empty and no stats server is heard on the local network.
official._host_wait_s: r15: the first player in the lobby is its host and presses Start; the server starts by itself only after this long (an idle host).

day_cycle._doc: r17: every match starts at night; the lobby host picks the length of one night and one day (Net.config.day_len: 120, 300 or 600 s). Maps listed here stay dark all match.

movement._doc_r12: Running like a body (Motor.run): acceleration falls from accel_start at rest to accel_top at sprint speed (about 0.5 s to a run, 1 s to a sprint); turn_grip sheds the motion that is not along the stick (a hard turn starts the run again); braking with no input is brake_slow at low speed and brake_fast at a sprint (a step or two). A standing jump with the stick held carries the body jump_carry m/s forward (jump_carry_back backward). Parkour: see src/player/parkour.gd.

bot_skill._doc: r22 bot difficulty (lobby Bot skill: easy | normal | hard | pro; anything else plays normal; --bot_skill=<skill> overrides on a server). reaction: seconds [min, max] from first sight to the trigger. aim_err: degrees [yaw, pitch] off at first sight, settling at settle deg/s; aim_lerp: how fast the view follows the target (per s); wobble: degrees of shake that never settles. fire_gate: radians off target the trigger is pulled at; fire_chance: per frame while on target; burst: seconds [min, max]. vision: x sight ranges; behind_dot: nobody is seen at a bearing whose dot with the view is below this (lower = wider, never through walls); hurt_react: reaction cap when shot by someone unseen. hold: x camp / overwatch time. Deathmatch endgame: a side down to end_alive standing, or end_contact_s without the team seeing or being hit by an enemy; then holds last at most end_camp_s (ambush) / end_watch_s (sniper), one per end_hold_gap_s, sweeps in between, and after end_hint_s more without contact the team gets a rough idea (20 m) of the nearest enemy. head_m: aims at the head beyond this range (0 never). tactics: Pro fighting (long gun at range, rush when out of rounds, push an opening, pre-aim, reload out of sight).
